notes: Corrected the flagged three-morpheme unit: rule 30 states that a pronominal suffix on the construct noun is no part of such a fusion, so 'upside down' is the preposition and noun only, and the suffix takes the written 'it' under rule 18.

The 'it' of 'wiping it' remains added, since that clause writes no pronominal morpheme; the two supplied-looking pronouns are treated differently because the Hebrew clauses differ, not because of English parallelism.
